description:
1. READ INPUTS: Parse paid_social_orders_2023.csv handling messy date formats and missing values; compute per-customer gross profit (GMV - COGS) excluding refunded orders over 12 months. Parse paid_social_cost_breakdown_2023.txt to extract all four CAC components: ad spend (1,800,000) + agency/channel service fee (1,068,000) + team cost (420,000) + voucher subsidies (108,000) = 3,396,000 total. Full blended CAC = 3,396,000 / 6,000 ≈ 566 CNY. The agent must NOT use the legacy revenue-only CAC of CNY 300.
2. COMPUTE LTV: 12-month gross profit LTV per customer = sum of (GMV - COGS - fulfillment - discount) for non-refunded orders across all paid social customers, divided by 120 customers. Must be on gross profit basis.
3. OUTPUT STRUCTURED REPORT (ltv_cac_report.md) with exactly 5 sections per SKILL.md: (1) Assumptions table with LTV window, metric basis, CAC scope all stated; (2) LTV/CAC numeric result and ratio; (3) Risk commentary identifying the weakest link (e.g., retention/repurchase rate assumption is fragile); (4) Recommended actions; (5) Reusable Python script block with ≥10 lines that can recompute the analysis.
4. QUALITY GATES: Must explicitly disclaim lifecycle assumptions (not claim false precision); must identify retention as a key risk factor; must show LTV:CAC ratio and payback period; must avoid the deprecated revenue-only formula from the legacy script in /scripts/legacy/.
